A.objective: Determine which represented billed revenue is associated with counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant conditions, and report each qualifying invoice with counterparty and contract identifiers as they appear in sources.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
entities_in_scope: contractual clauses bearing on change of control or assignment
entities_out_of_scope: contracts or invoices not represented in the data room

world_true: Invoice referents with amount, currency, billing period, and status as represented in sources.
Contract referents with identifiers as they appear in sources.
Counterparty names or identifiers as represented on invoices and contracts.

Presence or absence of specific contractual clause types in contract text (change-of-control consent/notice, change-of-control termination right, assignment consent/notice/restriction including affiliate-only or competitor prohibition).
purpose_policy: Acquisition-relevant condition: a purpose-defined subset of clauses — (a) requires consent or notice on change of control, (b) permits termination upon change of control, or (c) requires consent or notice before assignment (including assignment restricted except to affiliates, or assignment prohibited to a competitor).
Active contract for this purpose: a contract that is not an expired statement of work; expired SOW is explicitly not active.

Qualifying invoice: a represented invoice whose revenue exposure is under analysis when joined (asserted or left unresolved) to a counterparty on an active contract bearing an acquisition-relevant condition.
Association disposition asserted vs unresolved: purpose output encoding of whether billed name and contract counterparty are confidently the same commercial relationship for this report.

epistemic_requirements: Ground every asserted association in authoritative source evidence; do not infer joins from name similarity alone.
Missing or uncertain identity between a billed name and a contract counterparty must not be treated as a negative contractual finding.
When billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently associated, record association as unresolved rather than omitting the invoice or asserting the join.
Report identifiers exactly as they appear in sources (no silent canonicalization in the purpose output).

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Invoice is in scope for exposure analysis but the link between billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently established.

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Include every represented invoice that qualifies under purpose policy (active contract with acquisition-relevant condition) or that must be reported with association unresolved because identity prevents a confident join.
completeness_expectations.identifier_coverage: For each included invoice, populate amount, currency, period, status, billed_name, and contract_id from sources where available.
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: Do not emit closed-world negatives for missing identity; unresolved is the explicit non-assertion state.
completeness_expectations.output_completeness_receipt: Downstream passes should record completeness relative to the represented invoice universe and authoritative contract corpus, not an external oracle.

purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_rule: Expired statement of work is not an active contract.
purpose_specific_policies.association_threshold: asserted only when billed name and contract counterparty association is confident; otherwise unresolved.
purpose_specific_policies.missing_identity_policy: Never treat missing identity as evidence against a contractual finding.
purpose_specific_policies.join_dependency: May consume identity reconciliation from purpose B when available, but must not collapse unresolved identity into asserted exposure.

B.objective: Identify represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, company registry, and contracts; for each commercially relevant name or record, report whether it can be confidently treated as the same legal counterparty as other records, or whether identification remains unresolved.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.

required_output_shape.ordering: Sort links by left ascending, then right ascending.

world_true: Distinct referents for CRM accounts, billing billed names, registry company numbers, and contract filenames/parties as represented in sources.
Pairwise identity judgments with epistemic status SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED between referents in different identifier namespaces.
purpose_policy: Commercially relevant name or record: any record that must participate in connecting CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry legal entity for diligence.
Mechanical same-entity allowance: exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical equivalences under purpose policy (not automatic fuzzy name matching).
Similar-trade-name non-merge: distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party.
Required link set: every link needed to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship.

epistemic_requirements: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence from authoritative sources, not default compatibility or absence of proof.
Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative (DISTINCT) judgment; use UNRESOLVED when evidence is insufficient.
Permit explicit unresolved identity rather than forcing a binary merge decision.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT for the left-right pair.

completeness_expectations.link_coverage: Include every link required to connect CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and registry candidate legal entity for each commercially relevant relationship represented in sources.
completeness_expectations.pair_orientation: Emit directed left-right pairs per schema; symmetric judgment content should be represented consistently (one orientation per unordered pair unless schema requires both).
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: DISTINCT is allowed only with grounding; absence of proof must remain UNRESOLVED, not DISTINCT.
completeness_expectations.output_completeness_receipt: Completeness is relative to the set of required cross-system identity links implied by represented CRM, billing, contract, and registry records.

purpose_specific_policies.merge_prohibition: No global merge on string similarity alone.
purpose_specific_policies.mechanical_variant_rule: Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be reconciled mechanically.
purpose_specific_policies.registry_collision_rule: Similar trade names across distinct registry entities do not imply SAME_ENTITY.
purpose_specific_policies.required_link_topology: Links must span crm, billing, contract, and registry identifier forms sufficient to wire each commercially relevant relationship.

C.objective: Compute a commercial dependency view: identify counterparties that are commercially dependent under purpose-defined criteria, including open-invoice and active-contract obligation signals, or report dependency as unresolved when identity needed to join invoice and contract cannot be established.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
universe_scope.identifier_forms: Same as purpose B: crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:

required_output_shape.obligation_kinds_ordering: obligation_kinds must be a sorted list drawn from the enum.

world_true: Invoice open vs non-open status as represented in billing sources.
Contract active vs expired status and presence of exclusivity, auto-renewal, or rolling-term language in contract text.
Counterparty referents joinable to contracts and invoices when identity is known.
purpose_policy: Commercially dependent: both (1) a current commercial relationship — an open invoice OR an active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term — and (2) the active contract contains exclusivity, term auto-renewal, or rolling term that continues unless notice is given.
Current commercial relationship threshold for dependency analysis.
Expired contracts do not create current dependency.
A one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not establish current dependency.
Dependency status dependent vs unresolved: purpose output when identity join is confident vs when invoice-contract identity remains unresolved.

epistemic_requirements: If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report dependency status as unresolved rather than dependent or as a false negative.
Ground obligation_kinds in contract text evidence for the referenced contract_id.
Ground open_invoice_ids in billing source representation of invoice status.
Use purpose B identifier forms for counterparty; do not invent alternate identifier schemes.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Dependency cannot be confidently assessed because identity linking invoice(s) and contract counterparty is unresolved.

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Emit a dependency row for each contract-counterparty combination that is a candidate under purpose policy (current relationship plus declared obligation kind), including rows where status is unresolved due to identity.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: Populate counterparty, contract_id, open_invoice_ids (possibly empty), obligation_kinds (sorted subset of enum), and status for each row.
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: Do not emit status dependent when identity join is unresolved; unresolved is the explicit withholding of a positive dependency finding.
completeness_expectations.cross_purpose_dependency: May rely on purpose B identity links; unresolved identity from B must propagate to status unresolved here.

purpose_specific_policies.dependency_conjunction: Both current commercial relationship AND qualifying obligation kind on an active contract are required for status dependent.
purpose_specific_policies.expired_contract_exclusion: Expired contracts do not create current dependency.
purpose_specific_policies.historical_invoice_exclusion: One-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not establish current dependency.
purpose_specific_policies.identity_unresolved_propagation: Unresolved invoice-contract identity forces status unresolved, not dependent and not silently omitted.
